name: oka
description: No-Gradle Flutter Android build system: flutter assemble + direct Android SDK tools for 3-5x faster incremental builds, with plugin packaging, AAB support, and dependency recovery. Bundles agent skills.

interface.shortDescription: No-Gradle Flutter Android builds: flutter assemble + direct SDK tools, plugin packaging, AAB, dependency recovery.
interface.longDescription:
oka is a Dart CLI that replaces Gradle for Flutter Android builds. It runs flutter assemble and invokes Android SDK tools (aapt2, javac, d8, zipalign, apksigner) directly — no Gradle daemon, no AGP, no 30s+ configuration overhead per build.

Built-in surface:
- No-Gradle APK/AAB pipeline with plugin packaging (Maven/AAR deps, natives, res)
- Fast settings in oka.yaml: extra deps, extra assets, deeplinks, adaptive vector launcher icons
- Dependency recovery: runtime missing-class crashes map back to Maven artifacts
- Composable BuildStep pipeline with a Dart composition API

Bundled skills teach agents how to build, configure, and maintain oka projects.
defaultPrompt: Use oka to build my Flutter Android app without Gradle and install the APK on a connected device.
My app crashes at launch with NoClassDefFoundError — use oka's dependency recovery to fix it.
